text: Welcome, I see you have swelling in your right knee and a family history of similar issues. To narrow this down, can you tell me how long this swelling has been present and if you have experienced any trauma to the area?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia (Hemophilic Arthropathy).

The patient's age, spontaneous swelling after minor activity (playing in the park) without trauma, and the specific family history of an affected uncle on the maternal side strongly suggest a sex-linked recessive bleeding disorder.
